title: anon left open (mosquitto) — review required
description: anon runs with an open setting: allow_anonymous true. Open binds, trust auth, and disabled protections expose the service to unauthenticated networks. This lexical rule flags the setting; the reviewer confirms isolation or hardens it.
remediation: Apply password_file plus TLS and verify from an untrusted network.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the setting regardless of network isolation.
